headline: Interfaith Sanctuary says new Boise site changed its work
pages: Interfaith Sanctuary moved in February from Americana Boulevard in downtown Boise to a new facility on State Street, Boise State Public Radio reported on Nov. 18. Staff say the upgraded space has changed how they help unhoused people.
The story looks at how the shelter's approach has shifted since the move, a change that affects how Boise serves residents without housing.
